source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
reference: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.

source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.

reference: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
hypothesis: Cuomo, 53, alianza kazi yake ya gavana mapema mwaka huu na kusaini muswada mwezi uliopita kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.

source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".

source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
reference: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.

source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
reference: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.
hypothesis: Inatumia teknolojia ya satelaiti tofauti na teknolojia ya zamani ya rada ya ardhini ili kuruhusu wasimamizi wa ndege waone ndege kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapa marubani habari sahihi zaidi.

source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
reference: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.

source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
reference: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.
hypothesis: Hofu ya kukosa usafiri iliongeza uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila mashabiki wa timu.

source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
reference: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.
hypothesis: Uchunguzi uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida Science uliripoti juu ya kutokea kwa spishi mpya ya ndege kwenye Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Ekuado.

source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
reference: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.
hypothesis: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton nchini Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala nchini Sweden waliripoti kwamba spishi mpya zilibadilika katika vizazi viwili tu, ingawa iliaminika kwamba mchakato huu ulichukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaliana kati ya finch ya Darwin ya endemic, Geospiza fortes, na finch ya cactus ya wahamiaji, Geospiza conirostris.

source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
reference: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.
hypothesis: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa kwa njia mbalimbali, inaweza kutengenezwa kwa njia ndogo-ndogo.

source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
reference: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.
hypothesis: Inaweza kuunganishwa na kutengenezwa kwa waya, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, kuunganishwa kwa chuma, na kuunganishwa kwa chuma.

source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
reference: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa “miswada iliyoangazwa”.
hypothesis: Inaweza kufanywa nyembamba sana, na kushikamana na chuma kingine. Inaweza kufanywa nyembamba sana kwamba wakati mwingine ilitumiwa kupamba picha zilizopakwa kwa mikono katika vitabu vinavyoitwa "manuscripts zilizoangaziwa".

source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
reference: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.
hypothesis: Hii inaitwa kemikali ya pH. Unaweza kufanya kiashiria kwa kutumia maji ya kabichi nyekundu.

source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
reference: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.
hypothesis: Maji ya kabichi hubadilika rangi ikitegemea kemikali hiyo ikiwa na asidi au kioevu (alkali).

source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
reference: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.
hypothesis: Kiwango cha pH kinaonyeshwa na kiasi cha ioni za hidrojeni (H katika pH) katika kemikali ya kupimwa.

source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
reference: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).
hypothesis: Ioni za hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilikuwa na elektroni zao ziliondolewa (kwa kuwa atomu za hidrojeni zina protoni moja na elektroni moja).

source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
reference: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.
hypothesis: Zungusha vipande viwili vya unga pamoja na kisha, kwa mikono safi na yenye mvua, vifunge viwe mpira.

source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
reference: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.
hypothesis: Unyevu ulio kwenye mikono yako utachangia tabaka za nje, ambazo zitaonekana kuwa za ajabu na kutokeza aina fulani ya ganda.

source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
reference: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.
hypothesis: Katika majiji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro, karibu kila nyumba ilikuwa na vyoo vilivyounganishwa na mfumo wa maji taka.

source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
reference: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.
hypothesis: Mabaki ya mifumo ya maji taka yamepatikana katika nyumba za majiji ya Minoan ya Krete na Santorini huko Ugiriki.

source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
reference: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.
hypothesis: Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, vyoo wakati mwingine vilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za umma za kuogea ambapo wanaume na wanawake walikuwa pamoja katika kampuni iliyochanganywa.

source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
reference: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.
hypothesis: Unapopigia simu mtu aliye maelfu ya kilomita mbali, unatumia setilaiti.

source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
reference: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.
hypothesis: Setilaiti katika nafasi hupokea simu na kisha kuirejelea nyuma, karibu mara moja.

source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
reference: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.
hypothesis: Satellite hiyo ilitumwa angani kwa roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu angahewa la Dunia hubadili sehemu ya nuru na mwonekano wetu.

source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
reference: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.
hypothesis: Inachukua roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya meta 100 kuweka setilaiti au darubini angani.

source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
reference: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.
hypothesis: Gurudumu limebadilisha ulimwengu kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa ambalo gurudumu limefanya kwa ajili yetu ni kutupatia usafiri rahisi na wa haraka.

source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
reference: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.
hypothesis: Imetuletea gari-moshi, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya usafiri.

source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
reference: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.
hypothesis: Chini yao kuna paka wenye ukubwa wa kati ambao hula mawindo ya ukubwa wa kati kuanzia sungura hadi pembe na mbawala.

source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
reference: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.
hypothesis: Hatimaye, kuna paka wengi wadogo (ikiwa ni pamoja na paka wa nyumbani) ambao hula mawindo madogo mengi kama wadudu, wadudu, mjusi, na ndege.

source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
reference: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.
hypothesis: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni wazo la niche, kazi ya pekee ambayo kila paka anafanya ambayo humzuia asishindane na wengine.

source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
reference: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.
hypothesis: Simba ni paka wenye urafiki sana, nao huishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa vipande.

source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
reference: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.
hypothesis: Makundi ya kondoo hufanyizwa na waume watatu au zaidi, na pia wa kike na watoto 30.

source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
reference: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, wanawake hao wana uhusiano wa karibu na familia kubwa ya dada na binti.

source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
reference: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.
hypothesis: Simba hujiendesha kama makundi ya mbwa-mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza wanafanana na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) katika tabia, na pia ni hatari sana kwa mawindo yao.

source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
reference: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa ni mwanariadha mwenye umbo la mviringo, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka umbali mrefu na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano zaidi ya nguvu za mwanadamu mwenye nguvu.

source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
reference: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.
hypothesis: Tigrasi ni wa jamii moja (Genus Panthera) na simba, chui, na jaguar. Punda hawa wanne ndio pekee wanaoweza kunguruma.

source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
reference: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.
hypothesis: Kunguruma kwa simbamarara si kama kunguruma kwa sauti ya simba, bali ni kama maneno ya msemo wenye kelele.

source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
reference: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.
hypothesis: Ocelots kama kula wanyama wadogo. Wao kupata tumbili, nyoka, wadudu na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote kwamba ocelot kuwinda ni ndogo sana kuliko yeye ni.

source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
reference: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.
hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanaamini kwamba viumbe hao hufuata na kutafuta wanyama kwa kunusa, wakichunguza mahali walipo.

source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
reference: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.
hypothesis: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana katika giza na maono ya usiku, na kusonga kwa siri sana, pia. Ocelots kuwinda mawindo yao kwa kuchanganyika na mazingira yao kisha kuruka juu ya mawindo yao.

source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
reference: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.
hypothesis: Wakati kundi dogo la viumbe hai (idadi ndogo ya watu) kupata kutengwa na idadi kubwa ya watu kwamba wao alikuja kutoka (kama kama wao hoja juu ya safu ya milima au mto, au kama wao hoja kwa kisiwa kipya ili hawawezi kwa urahisi hoja nyuma) wao mara nyingi kupata wenyewe katika mazingira tofauti kuliko walikuwa katika kabla.

source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
reference: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.
hypothesis: Hii mazingira mapya ina rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, hivyo idadi mpya itahitaji sifa tofauti au marekebisho ya kuwa mshindani nguvu kuliko walivyohitaji kabla.

source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
reference: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.
hypothesis: Idadi ya awali haijabadilika hata kidogo, bado wanahitaji mabadiliko sawa na zamani.

source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
reference: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.
hypothesis: Baada ya muda, kadiri idadi mpya ya watu inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, ndivyo wanavyoanza kuonekana tofauti na idadi nyingine.

source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
reference: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.
hypothesis: Hatimaye, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, jamii hizo mbili zitakuwa tofauti sana hivi kwamba haziwezi kuitwa spishi moja.

source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
reference: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.
hypothesis: Tunaita mchakato huu aina, ambayo tu ina maana ya malezi ya aina mpya. aina ni matokeo ya kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.

source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
reference: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).
hypothesis: Mimea hutokeza oksijeni ambayo wanadamu hupumua, na huingiza kaboni dioksidi ambayo wanadamu hutoa (yaani, huvuta pumzi).

source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
reference: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli
hypothesis: Mimea hutengeneza chakula kutokana na jua kwa kutumia usanidi-mwanga. Pia huandaa kivuli.

source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
reference: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.
hypothesis: Sisi kufanya nyumba zetu kutoka mimea na kufanya nguo kutoka mimea. chakula zaidi kwamba sisi kula ni mimea. bila mimea, wanyama hawezi kuishi.

source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
reference: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.
hypothesis: Mosasaurus alikuwa mnyama-mwitu mkuu wa wakati wake, kwa hiyo hakuogopa chochote isipokuwa mosasaurs wengine.

source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
reference: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.
hypothesis: Mihanga yake mirefu ilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 yenye makali kama makali ya wembe, na pia meno mengine kwenye sehemu ya juu ya mdomo wake, na hivyo hakuna kitu chochote kilichokutana nayo ambacho kingeweza kutoroka.

source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
reference: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.
hypothesis: Hatujui kwa hakika, lakini huenda alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Chakula chake kilikuwa na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasauri wengine, na huenda hata alikuwa mlozi.

source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
reference: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.
hypothesis: Pia, chui huyo alivamia chochote kilichogonga maji; hata dinosauri mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangeweza kumshinda.

source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
reference: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse
hypothesis: Ingawa chakula chao kilikuwa cha kawaida kwetu, Waroma walikuwa na vyakula vyao vya karamu vya ajabu au visivyo vya kawaida, kutia ndani nguruwe-mwitu, paa, konokono, na aina ya mchwa anayeitwa dormouse

source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
reference: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.
hypothesis: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba wakati maskini na mwanamke walipokula chakula chao wakiwa wameketi kwenye viti, matajiri walipenda kula pamoja kwenye karamu ambapo walilala kando huku wakila.

source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
reference: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.
hypothesis: Chakula cha Waroma wa kale hakikuweza kutia ndani vyakula vilivyoletwa Ulaya kutoka Amerika au Asia katika karne zilizofuata.

source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
reference: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Warumi wa kale aliyewahi kula turkey.

source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
reference: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.
hypothesis: Wababiloni walijenga hekalu kuu kwa kila mungu wao ambalo lilionwa kuwa makao ya mungu huyo.

source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
reference: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.
hypothesis: Watu walitoa dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani walijaribu kutimiza mahitaji ya miungu hiyo kupitia sherehe na sherehe.

source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
reference: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.
hypothesis: Kila hekalu lilikuwa na ua wa hekalu ulio wazi na kisha patakatifu pa ndani ambapo makuhani pekee ndio wangeweza kuingia.

source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
reference: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.
hypothesis: Nyakati nyingine minara ya kipekee yenye umbo la piramidi, inayoitwa ziggurats, ilijengwa ili kuwa sehemu ya mahekalu.

source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
reference: Sehemu ya juu ilikuwa makao matakatifu ya mungu.
hypothesis: Juu ya mnara huo kulikuwa na mahali pa pekee pa ibada kwa ajili ya mungu huyo.

source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
reference: Katika hali joto ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.
hypothesis: Katika hali ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati yenye joto, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.

source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
reference: Sehemu kubwa ya maisha ya familia ya Kiebrania ilifanyikia nje.
hypothesis: Maisha ya familia ya Waebrania yalifanywa nje kwa ukawaida.

source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
reference: Wanawake walifanya mapishi kwenye yadi; stoo zilikuwa kaunta wazi tu zilizoelekea barabarani. Mawe yalitumika kujengea barabara.
hypothesis: Wanawake walipika chakula uwanjani; maduka yalikuwa tu meza zilizo wazi zilizoelekea barabarani.

source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
reference: Hakukua na misitu mikubwa kwenye ardhi ya Canaan, kwa hivyo mbao ziliuzwa kwa bei ghali mno.
hypothesis: Hakukuwa na misitu mikubwa katika nchi ya Kanaani, kwa hiyo mbao zilikuwa ghali sana.

source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
reference: Greenland ilikuwa na watu chache. Katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik aliye Mwekundu alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati wa kusafiri Magharibi zaidi, aliipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.
hypothesis: Greenland ilikuwa imepangwa kidogo. katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik Red alikuwa uhamishoni kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati kusafiri zaidi magharibi, kupatikana Greenland na jina lake Greenland.

source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
reference: Lakina licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo yalikuwa tayari yanaishi huko wakati huo.
hypothesis: Lakini licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Waeskimo tayari yalikaa huko wakati huo.

source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
reference: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa ya 'Kiskandinavia', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, mila na historia za Denmaki, Uswidi, Norway na Aislandi.
hypothesis: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa 'Scandinavian', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, desturi na historia ya Denmark, Sweden, Norway na Iceland.

source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
reference: Iwapo umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.
hypothesis: Ikiwa umewahi kutazama sinema National Treasure, huenda ukafikiri kwamba ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Azimio la Uhuru.

source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
reference: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati, si ramani ya hazina.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli, ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati hiyo, hiyo si ramani ya hazina.

source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
reference: Nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kuliandikwa maneno “Tangazo halisi la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776”. Maandishi hayo yako katika sehemu ya chini ya hati, juu chini.
hypothesis: Kwenye nyuma ya Azimio la Uhuru kulikuwa na maneno "Ajali ya Kwanza ya Uhuru ya Julai 4, 1776".

source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
reference: Wakati hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina vipimo vya inchi 29¾ kwa inchi 24½) ilikunjwa kwa uhifadhi.
hypothesis: Ingawa hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeandika hati hiyo, inajulikana kwamba mwanzoni mwa historia ya Biblia, hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina ukubwa wa inchi 293⁄4 na inchi 241⁄2) ilifungwa ili ihifadhiwe.

source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
reference: Kwa hivyo, kuna uwezekano kuwa nukuu liliongezwa liwe kama ishara.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, inaelekea kwamba alama hiyo iliongezwa tu kama alama.

source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
reference: Utuaji siku ya shambulio na mapigano yaliyofuata yalikuwa yameweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.
hypothesis: Siku ya D na vita vilivyofuata vilikuwa vimeikomboa kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.

source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
reference: Ilitawaliwa na Wafaransa wa “Vichy”. Hawa walikuwa watu wa Ufaransa ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mnamo 1940 na kufanya kazi na washambulizi badala ya kupigana nao.
hypothesis: Ilikuwa ikiongozwa na Wafaransa wa "Vichy", yaani, Wafaransa waliofanya amani na Wajerumani mwaka wa 1940 na kufanya kazi pamoja na wavamizi badala ya kupigana nao.

source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
reference: Mnamo Agosti 15 1940, Majeshi ya Kirafiki yalishambulia Ufaransa kusini, shambulio liliitwa "Operesheni Dragoon".
hypothesis: Mnamo Agosti 15, 1940, Wajumbe wa Allies walivamia kusini mwa Ufaransa, uvamizi huo uliitwa "Operation Dragoon".

source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
reference: Kwa kipindi cha majuma mawili tu vikosi vya Marekani na Ufaransa Huru vilikuwa vimekomboa Ufaransa kusini na vilikuwa vikielekea Ujerumani.
hypothesis: Katika muda wa majuma mawili tu, majeshi ya Marekani na ya Ufaransa Huru yalikuwa yameikomboa kusini mwa Ufaransa na yalikuwa yakielekea Ujerumani.

source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
reference: Ustaarabu ni utamaduni wa umoja unaoshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.
hypothesis: Utamaduni ni utamaduni wa kipekee ulioshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.

source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
reference: Neno ustaarabu hutoka katika civilis la Kilatini, ambalo linamaanisha ya kiraia, linalohusiana na civis la Kilatini, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha mji au jimbo la mji, na ambalo kwa namna fulani linaelezea ukubwa wa jamii.
hypothesis: Neno ustaarabu linatokana na civilis ya Kilatini, maana yake ni raia, kuhusiana na civis ya Kilatini, maana yake ni raia, na civitas, maana yake ni mji au mji-serikali, na pia kwa namna fulani hufafanua ukubwa wa jamii.

source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
reference: Majimbo ya miji hutanguliza mataifa. Utamaduni wa kistaarabu huashiria kupitishwa kwa maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, wayo wa kitamaduni unaoendelea kukaa kwa muda na usambazaji wenye haki.
hypothesis: Mji-serikali ni precursors ya mataifa. utamaduni ustaarabu maana ya kupitisha maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, muda mrefu utamaduni footprint na usawa kueneza.

source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
reference: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hutoweka bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria na kukosa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu barabara.
hypothesis: Utamaduni mdogo mara nyingi hupotea bila kuacha ushahidi wa kihistoria na kushindwa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu sahihi.

source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
reference: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati – huku Bunge la Marekani likiwa ndiyo sehemu yake pekee – chini ya Vifungu vya Shirikisho.
hypothesis: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali ya kati ya dhaifu na Congress ikiwa sehemu yake pekee chini ya Vifungu vya Jumuiya.

source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
reference: Kongamano lilikosa uwezo wowote wa kuweka ushuru, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na mtendaji wa kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka ya taifa, ambao mara nyingi hawakuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza sheria zake.
hypothesis: Congress hakuwa na mamlaka yoyote ya kuwekeza kodi, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na serikali ya kitaifa au mahakama, ilitegemea mamlaka ya serikali, ambayo mara nyingi haikuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza vitendo vyake vyote.

source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
reference: Pia haikuwa na mamlaka ya kupuuza sheria na orodha za ushuru kati ya majimbo.
hypothesis: Pia, haukuwa na mamlaka ya kutangua sheria za kodi na ushuru kati ya majimbo.

source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
reference: Vifungu vilihitaji ridhaa ya pamoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kurekebishwa na majimbo yalichukulia serikali kuu kwa mzaha sana kiasi kwamba mara nyingi wawakilishi wao hawakuwepo.
hypothesis: Makala hizo zilihitaji idhini ya umoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kuhaririwa na majimbo yalichukua serikali kuu kwa urahisi sana kwamba wawakilishi wao mara nyingi hawakuwepo.

source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
reference: Timu ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya soka ya Ujerumani ndiyo timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na ilikuwa bingwa wa kikombe cha dunia cha FIFA mwaka wa 2006.
hypothesis: Timu ya taifa ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya taifa ya Ujerumani ni timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na walikuwa mabingwa wa Kombe la Dunia la FIFA mwaka 2006.

source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
reference: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na kandanda, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa wavu, polo ya majini, mchezo wa uzio, raga, uendeshaji baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gogo na mashindano ya magari ya F1.
hypothesis: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na mpira wa miguu, mpira wa kikapu, volleyball, water-polo, uzio, rugby, baiskeli, hockey barafu, roller hockey na F1 magari racing.

source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
reference: Spoti za msimu wa baridi ni maarufu sana katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, ambako Waitaliano hushindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na ya Olimpiki.
hypothesis: Michezo ya majira ya baridi kali ni maarufu zaidi katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, na Waitaliano hushiriki katika michezo ya kimataifa na michezo ya Olimpiki.

source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
reference: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
hypothesis: Japani ina visiwa karibu 7,000 (vikubwa zaidi ni Honshu), na hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kwa ukubwa duniani!

source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
reference: Kwa sababu ya mafungu/vikundi vya visiwa Japani ilivyo navyo, mara nyingi Japani huitwa, kwa msimamo wa kijiografia, "funguvisiwa"
hypothesis: Kwa sababu ya kundi/kundi la visiwa Japan ina, Japan ni mara nyingi inajulikana, juu ya msimamo wa kijiografia, kama "Visiwa"

source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
reference: Taiwan ilianza nyuma kitambo katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Kiingereza wanaopita hurekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.
hypothesis: Taiwan kuanza mbali nyuma katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Ulaya kupita kumbukumbu jina kisiwa  kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa nzuri.

source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
reference: Mnamo 1624, kampuni ya Dutch East India ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, kuanzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka na kuwaajili wafanyakazi wa Kichina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba ya mpunga na sukari.
hypothesis: Katika 1624, Kampuni ya Uholanzi ya India Mashariki ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, na kuanza mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka ya asili na kuajiri wafanyakazi wa China kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba yake ya mchele na sukari.

source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
reference: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Milki ya Qing mnamo 1885.
hypothesis: Mwaka 1683, jeshi la nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) lilichukua udhibiti wa pwani za magharibi na kaskazini mwa Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kuwa mkoa wa Dola ya Qing mwaka 1885.

source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
reference: Mnamo 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika vita vya kwanza vya Sino-Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing yatia sahihi mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao kwao inadhihirisha uhuru juu ya Taiwan hadi Japani, ambayo inaongoza kisiwa hadi 1945.
hypothesis: Mwaka wa 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika Vita vya Kwanza vya China na Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing inatia sahihi Mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao unatoa uhuru wa Taiwan kwa Japani, ambayo inatawala kisiwa hicho hadi 1945.

source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
reference: Machu Picchu ina mifumo kuu mitatu, kwa majina Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba chenye Madirisha Matatu.
hypothesis: Machu Picchu ina sehemu tatu kuu, yaani, Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba cha Madirisha Matatu.

source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
reference: Nyumba nyingi kwenye kingo za majengo hayo tata zilijengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii taswira bora ya jinsi zilivyokuwa mwanzoni.
hypothesis: Majengo mengi yaliyo kwenye kingo za eneo hilo yamejengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii wazo zuri zaidi la jinsi yalivyokuwa mwanzoni.

source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
reference: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerejeshwa na urejesho unaendelea hadi leo.
hypothesis: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia 30 ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerudishwa na kazi hiyo inaendelea hadi leo.

source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
reference: Kwa mfano, umbizo la upigaji picha tuli wa kawaida zaidi duniani ni milimita 35, ambayo ndiyo iliyokuwa saizi kuu ya filamu katika zama za sinema za kikale.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, kawaida zaidi bado picha ya upigaji picha format katika dunia ni 35mm, ambayo ilikuwa kubwa ukubwa filamu katika mwisho wa enzi ya filamu analog.

source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
reference: Bado inatolewa hadi wa leo, lakini kwa umuhimu zaidi uwiano wa kipengele chake umerithiwa na umbizo za kihisio cha picha za kamera za kidijitali.
hypothesis: Bado hutengenezwa leo, lakini muhimu zaidi uwiano wake wa sura umerithiwa na muundo wa sensorer ya picha ya kamera ya dijiti.

source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
reference: Muundo wa 35mm kwa kweli, kwa kiasi Fulani unachanganya, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.
hypothesis: Muundo wa 35mm ni kweli, kwa kiasi fulani confusingly, 36mm kwa upana kwa 24mm kwa urefu.

source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
reference: Uwiano-vipimo wa muundo huu (kugawa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa namba kamili) basi husemekana kuwa 3:2.
hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, uwiano wa sura za picha hizo (unagawanywa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa nambari nzima) unasemekana kuwa 3:2.

source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.

source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.

source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
reference: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa kitaifa wa barabara hufai kiuchumi kwa magari machache tu, kwa hivyo mbinu mpya za uzalishaji zinakuzwa ili kupunguza gharama ya umiliki wa magari.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, barabara za nchi nzima haziwezi kutumiwa na magari machache tu, kwa hiyo mbinu mpya za kutengeneza magari zinatengenezwa ili kupunguza gharama za magari.

source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
reference: Umiliki wa magari kwa wingi pia hupelekea matukio mengi ya ajali za barabarani, ambazo hupelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika matibabu za kutengeneza miili iliyovunjika.
hypothesis: Pia, kuongezeka kwa magari kunaongeza hatari ya aksidenti barabarani, na hilo linasababisha kubuniwa kwa mbinu mpya za matibabu za kurekebisha miili iliyoharibika.

source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
reference: Uroma ulikuwa na kipengele kikubwa cha maamuzi ya kitamaduni yaliyochochewa na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.
hypothesis: Uharamia ulikuwa na sehemu kubwa ya utambulisho wa kitamaduni, uliotokana na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte, na Schlegel.

source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
reference: Katika muktadha wa Uroma, jiografia ilifinyanga watu, na kwa mpito wa wakati mila na tamaduni zilizohusiana na jiografia zilizuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na hali ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizolazimishwa kiholela.
hypothesis: Katika muktadha wa Uromantiki, jiografia ilibuni watu, na baada ya muda desturi na utamaduni unaohusiana na jiografia hiyo uliibuka, na hizi, zikiwa katika maelewano na mahali pa jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizowekwa kwa hiari.

source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
reference: Jinsi Paris inavyojulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo wa ulimwengu wa kisasa, Konstantinople ilichukuliwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo wa Uropa ya kikabaila.
hypothesis: Kama vile Paris inavyojulikana kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo ya ulimwengu wa kisasa, Constantinople ilionwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo ya Ulaya ya kifahari.

source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
reference: Inajulikana kwa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza takribani 400 A.D. na ilidumu hadi karibu 1100 A.D.
hypothesis: Sifa yake ya kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza mwaka wa 400 BK na kuendelea hadi mwaka wa 1100 BK.

source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
reference: Hali yake ilizorota wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapambanaji wa kidini walikuwa wamerejea na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo vilivyokuwa na thamani ya juu kuliko vile vilivyotolewa na masoko ya Bizanti.
hypothesis: Hali yake ilipungua wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapiganaji wa Msalaba walikuwa wamerudi wakiwa na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo ambavyo vilithaminiwa zaidi kuliko vile masoko ya Byzantine yalivyotoa.

source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
reference: Ilikuwa wakati huu ambapo uhamisho wa Jiji la Mtindo kutoka Konstantinopo hadi Parisi ulifanyika.
hypothesis: Ilikuwa wakati huu kwamba uhamisho wa jina la Mji Mkuu wa Mtindo kutoka Constantinople hadi Paris ulifanywa.

source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
reference: Staili ya Kigothi ilifikia kilele katika kipindi kati ya karne za 10-11 na karne ya 14.
hypothesis: Mtindo wa Gothic ulifikia kilele chake katika kipindi cha kati ya karne ya 10 na 11 na karne ya 14.

source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
reference: Hapo mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa na tamaduni za Baizantini kutoka mashariki.
hypothesis: Mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa sana na utamaduni wa Byzantine mashariki.

source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
reference: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia hafifu za mawasiliano, mitindo ya magharibi ilibakia nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia za mawasiliano za polepole, mitindo ya magharibi ingeweza kushindwa kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.

source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
reference: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa Zama za Kati Uropa magharibi ilianza kuendeleza staili yao wenyewe. Mojawapo ya maendeleo makubwa zaidi ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya krusedi watu walianza kutumia vifungo kukazia nguo.
hypothesis: kuelekea mwisho wa Zama za Kati Ulaya Magharibi ilianza kuendeleza mtindo wao wenyewe. moja ya maendeleo makubwa ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya misalaba watu walianza kutumia vifungo kwa kufunga nguo.

source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa kwa uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha tu kukimu mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.
hypothesis: Kilimo cha kujitegemea ni kilimo kinachofanywa kwa ajili ya uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha kukidhi mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.

source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
reference: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni mfumo rahisi, aghalabu wa kikaboni, unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa na asilia kwa eneo husika, pamoja na mzunguko wa mimea au mbinu mbadala zilizo rahisi ili kuboresha mavuno.
hypothesis: Kilimo cha kujitegemea ni mfumo rahisi, mara nyingi kikaboni, kwa kutumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa za asili ya eneo la ikolojia pamoja na mzunguko wa mazao au mbinu zingine rahisi ili kuongeza mavuno.

source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
reference: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walijihusisha na kilimo cha kujikimu na hii bado ndiyo hali katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida wakulima wengi walikuwa wakifanya kazi ya kilimo cha kujitegemea na bado ndivyo ilivyo katika nchi nyingi zinazoendelea.

source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
reference: Utamaduni mdogo huwaleta pamoja watu walio wa mafikira sawa na ambao wanahisi kuwa wametengwa na viwango vya kijamii na kuwaruhusu kuendeleza hisia za utambulisho.
hypothesis: Utamaduni huleta pamoja watu wenye nia moja ambao huhisi kupuuzwa na viwango vya jamii na huwawezesha kukuza hisia ya kitambulisho.

source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
reference: Vikundi vidogo vya tamaduni vinaweza kuwa vya kipekee kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, daraja, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki.
hypothesis: Utamaduni wa chini unaweza kuwa tofauti kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, darasa, eneo, na / au jinsia ya wanachama.

source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
reference: Sifa zinazofanya utamaduni mdogo kuwa wa kipekee huenda zikawa za kilugha, kiurembo, kidini, kisiasa, kijiografia au mchanganyiko wa vipengele.
hypothesis: Sifa zinazoamua utamaduni wa chini kuwa tofauti zinaweza kuwa lugha, aesthetic, kidini, kisiasa, ngono, kijiografia, au mchanganyiko wa sababu.

source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
reference: Wanachama wa utamaduni mdogo mdogo kwa mara nyingi huashiria uanachama wao kupitia mitindo ya kipekee ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo ya kimavazi, tabia na lugha.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi washiriki wa utamaduni wa chini huonyesha ushirika wao kupitia matumizi ya kipekee na ya mfano ya mtindo, ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo, tabia, na sargo.

source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
reference: Mojawapo ya mbinu maarufu zinatozumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana ni kutumia mifano michache sikitishi ya watoto ambao, kupitia mapuuza, mikosi, kunyanyaswa kimakusudi, hawakushirikishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wanapokua.
hypothesis: Njia moja ya kawaida inayotumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana na wengine ni kutumia visa vichache vya watoto ambao hawakuwa na uhusiano mzuri na watu wazima walipokuwa wakikua kwa sababu ya kupuuzwa, kutendewa vibaya kimakusudi, au kwa sababu ya msiba.

source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
reference: Watoto kama hao huitwa "katili" au jeuri. Watoto wengine katili wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika hali nyingine huu kuachwa kwa watoto kulitokana na wazazi kukataa upungufu mkubwa wa kiakili au mwili kwa mtoto.
hypothesis: Watoto kama hao huitwa "wa mwitu" au wa mwitu. Watoto wengine wa mwitu wamefungwa na watu (kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika baadhi ya kesi hii kuachwa kwa mtoto kulitokana na kukataliwa kwa wazazi wa ulemavu mkubwa wa akili au mwili wa mtoto.

source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
reference: Huenda watoto wasiotagusana walipitia unyanyasaji mkuu au kiwewe utotoni mwao kabla ya kuachiliwa au kutoroka.
hypothesis: Huenda watoto wa mwitu wakawa wameathiriwa vibaya sana au kuumia sana kabla ya kuachwa au kukimbia.

source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
reference: Wengine wanadaiwa kulewa na wanyama; wengine wanasemekana kuishi porini kivyao.
hypothesis: Wengine wanadai kwamba walilelewa na wanyama; wengine wanasema kwamba waliishi peke yao porini.

source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
reference: Anapolelewa kabisa na wanyama wasio wa kibinadamu, mtoto katili huonyesha tabia (ndani ya mipaka ya kimwili) karibu kabisa kama zile za mnyama mahsusi wa utunzaji, kama vile hofu au upurukushani wake kwa wanadamu.
hypothesis: Mtoto mwitu anapokuwa amelelewa kabisa na wanyama wengine, anaonyesha tabia (ndani ya mipaka ya kimwili) zinazofanana kabisa na zile za wanyama wa kutunza, kama vile woga au kutojali wanadamu.

source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
reference: Wakati elimu ya msingi wa mradi kunapaswa kufanya elimu kuwa rahisi na ya kupendeza zaidi, udungu huenda hatua zaidi.
hypothesis: Wakati kujifunza kwa msingi wa mradi unapaswa kufanya kujifunza rahisi na ya kuvutia zaidi, scaffolding huenda hatua zaidi.

source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
reference: Mbinu za mafunzo si njia ya kusoma lakini huduma ambayo hutoa usaidizi kwa watu ambao wanapitia hali mpya ya masomo kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.
hypothesis: Scaffolding si njia ya kujifunza lakini badala misaada ambayo hutoa msaada kwa watu ambao ni kupitia uzoefu mpya ya kujifunza kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.

source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
reference: Majukwaa yanaweza kuwa dhahiri na pia halisi, kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya jukwaa lakini pia ndivyo kilivyo kile kijitu cha karatasi katika Microsoft Office.
hypothesis: Scaffolds inaweza kuwa wote virtual na halisi, kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya scaffold lakini hivyo ni kidogo paperclip mtu katika Microsoft Office.

source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
reference: Majukwaa Pepe yamewekwa ndani ya programu kwa kusudi la kuhoji, kushawishi, na kuelezea taratibu ambazo huenda zilikuwa changamoto kubwa kwa mwanafunzi kushughulikia peke yake.
hypothesis: Scaffolds Virtual ni ndani ya programu na ni maana ya kuuliza, kuuliza, na kueleza taratibu ambazo zinaweza kuwa changamoto kwa mwanafunzi kushughulikia peke yake.

source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
reference: Watoto huwekwa kwenye Huduma ya Malezi kwa sababu nyingine nyingi ambazo huanzia kutelekezwa hadi kudhulumiwa na hata unyang’anyi.
hypothesis: Watoto huwekwa katika makao ya kulea kwa sababu mbalimbali, kama vile kupuuzwa, kutendwa vibaya, na hata kunyanyaswa.

source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
reference: Hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kukua katika mazingira ambayo hayaelimishi, huyajali, hayafundishi, lakini wanafanya hivyo.
hypothesis: Hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kulelewa katika mazingira yasiyo na upendo, ya kujali, na ya kuelimisha, lakini ndivyo ilivyo.

source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
reference: Tunadhania Mfumo wa Huduma ya Kulea kuwa eneo la usalama kwa watoto hawa.
hypothesis: Tunaona kwamba mfumo wa kuwatunza watoto ni mahali salama kwa watoto hao.

source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
reference: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa makao salama, walezi wenye upendo, elimu imara, na mfumo wa afya unaoaminika.
hypothesis: Mfumo wetu wa kulea watoto wa kambo unapaswa kutoa makao salama, watunzaji wenye upendo, elimu thabiti, na utunzaji wa afya wenye kutegemeka.

source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
reference: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa mahitaji haya yote ambayo yalikosekana nyumbani walikotolewa awali.
hypothesis: Wazazi wa kambo wanapaswa kuwapa watoto mahitaji yote ambayo walikosa katika nyumba waliyoachiwa.

source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
reference: Mtandao unachanganya vitu vya mawasiliano ya kundi la watu na ya kati ya mtu na mtu.
hypothesis: Internet huchanganya mambo ya mawasiliano ya watu wengi na ya watu binafsi.

source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
reference: Tabia za kipekee za mtandao hupelekea vipimo zaidi kuhusu matumizi na mbinu za kuridhisha.
hypothesis: Sifa tofauti za mtandao kusababisha vipimo vya ziada katika suala la matumizi na kuridhika mbinu.

source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
reference: Kwa mfano, "kujifunza" na "ushirikiano" kunapendekezwa kama vichochezi muhimu kwa matumizi ya mtandao (James na wengine, 1995).
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, kujifunza na socialisation ni alipendekeza kama motisha muhimu kwa ajili ya matumizi ya mtandao (James et al., 1995).

source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
reference: Kushiriki kwa kibinafsi na "mahusiano endelezi" pia yalitambuliwa na Eighmey na McCord (1998) kama vipengele vipya vya motisha walipichunguza mjibizo wa hadhira katika tovuti.
hypothesis: husika binafsi na kuendelea mahusiano pia walikuwa kutambuliwa kama vipengele vipya motisha na Eighmey na McCord (1998) wakati wao kuchunguza maoni ya watazamaji kwa tovuti.

source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
reference: Matumizi ya video za kurekodi imesababisha uvumbuzi muhimu katika tafsiri ya sauti ndogo, kusongeshwa kwa uso ambao hudumu sekunde ndogo kadhaa.
hypothesis: Matumizi ya kurekodi video yamesababisha ugunduzi muhimu katika ufafanuzi wa maonyesho madogo, harakati za uso ambazo hudumu kwa milisecond chache.

source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
reference: Hususan, inadaiwa kuwa mtu anaweza kutambua ikiwa mtu anadanganya kwa kufasiri ishara ndogondogo kwa njia sahihi.
hypothesis: Hasa, inasemekana kwamba mtu anaweza kugundua kama mtu anadanganya kwa kutafsiri maneno madogo kwa usahihi.

source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
reference: Oliver Sacks, katika gazeti lake Hotuba ya Rais, alionyesha namna watu ambao hawawezi kuelewa hotuba kutokana na uharibifu wa ubongo hata hivyo wana uwezo kwa kutathmini ukweli kwa usahihi.
hypothesis: Katika makala yake The President's Speech, Oliver Sacks alionyesha jinsi watu ambao hawawezi kuelewa usemi kwa sababu ya kuharibika kwa ubongo bado wanavyoweza kupima unyofu kwa usahihi.

source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
reference: Hata anapendekeza kwamba uwezo kama huo wa kufasiri tabia za binadamu unaweza kushirikishwa wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kufugwa.
hypothesis: Hata anasema kwamba wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kufugwa wanaweza kufafanua tabia za wanadamu.

source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
reference: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna makundi mawili ya utofauti wa jeni: fiche na zilizoelezewa.
hypothesis: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna aina mbili za mabadiliko ya maumbile: yaliyofichwa na yaliyoonyeshwa.

source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
reference: Mabadiliko huongeza tofauti za kimaumbile, na uchaguzi huyaondoa katika mkusanyiko wa tofauti zilizoonyeshwa.
hypothesis: Mabadiliko huongeza tofauti mpya za maumbile, na uteuzi huondoa kutoka kwenye kundi la tofauti zilizoonyeshwa.

source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
reference: Mabadiliko ya uchangaji ya utengaji na uchanganyaji tena huku na huko kati ya vidimbwi hivyo viwili kwa kila kizazi.
hypothesis: Segregation na mchanganyiko upya shuffle tofauti mbele na nyuma kati ya mabwawa mawili na kila kizazi.

source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
reference: Nje kwenye savana, ni vigumu kwa wanyama wakuu waliyo na mfumo wa kuyeyusha chakula tumboni kama wa binadamu kutoshelezeza mahitaji ya tindikali-za-amino zao kutoka kwa vifaa vya mimea vilivyomo
hypothesis: Katika misitu, ni vigumu kwa chembe za msingi zenye mfumo wa kumeng'enya chakula kama wanadamu kutosheleza mahitaji yao ya asidi-amino kutokana na mimea inayopatikana.

source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
reference: Waaidha, kukosa kufanya hivyo kuna matokeo mazito: udidimiaji wa ukuaji, utapiamlo, na hatimaye kifo.
hypothesis: Isitoshe, kutofanya hivyo kunaweza kusababisha madhara makubwa: kushuka moyo, utapiamlo, na mwishowe kifo.

source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
reference: Rasilimali za mimea zinazofikiwa kwa urahisi zingekuwa protini zinazopatikana katika majani na kunde, lakini hizi ni ngumu kwa wale wa kundi la mammalia wa hali ya juu kama sisi kusaga isipokuwa kama zimepikwa.
hypothesis: Rasilimali za mimea ambazo zinapatikana kwa urahisi zaidi ni protini zinazopatikana katika majani na mboga, lakini ni vigumu kwa wanyama kama sisi kuzipima isipokuwa zipikwe.

source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
reference: Kwa kulinganisha, vyakula vya wanyama (siafu, mchwa, mayai) si kwamba vinameng’enywa kwa urahisi tu, lakini pia hutoa protini zenye kiwango kikubwa ambazo zina asidi muhimu za amino.
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, vyakula vya wanyama (chungu, mchwa, mayai) si rahisi kuviruza tu bali pia vina protini nyingi sana ambazo zina asidi zote muhimu za amino.

source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
reference: Mambo yote yakizingatiwa, hatupaswi kushangaa kama wahenga wetu walitatua “shida yao ya protini” kwa njia sawa na zile nyani wa savanna hufanya leo.
hypothesis: Kwa kuzingatia mambo yote, hatupaswi kushangaa ikiwa mababu zetu walitatua "tatizo lao la protini" kwa njia ileile ambayo sokwe katika msituni hufanya leo.

source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
reference: Ukatizaji wa usingizi ni mchakato wa kuamka kimakusudi wakati wa usingizi wako wa kawaida na kupatwa na usingizi muda mfupi baadaye (dakika 10-60).
hypothesis: Kukatiza usingizi ni kuamka kwa makusudi wakati wa kipindi cha kawaida cha usingizi na kulala muda mfupi baadaye (dakika 10 hadi 60).

source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
reference: Hili linaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia saa ya kengele isiyo na kelele kubwa sana ili kukufanya upate fahamu bila kukuamsha kabisa.
hypothesis: Hilo linaweza kufanywa kwa urahisi kwa kutumia saa ya kuamusha sauti isiyo na sauti ili kukuamsha bila kukuamsha kabisa.

source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
reference: Kama utajipata ukiweka upya saa ya kengele katika usingizi wako, inaweza kuwekwa upande mwingine wa chumba, ili kukulazimu kuondoka kitandani kuizima.
hypothesis: Ikiwa utaona kwamba unaacha kutumia saa hiyo unapolala, unaweza kuiweka upande mwingine wa chumba, na hivyo kulazimika kuamka ili uizimishe.

source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
reference: Chaguo zingine za midundobayolojia huhusisha unywaji mwingi (hususan wa maji au chai, dawa maarufu) kabla ya kulala, hali inayomlazimu mtu kuamka ili kwenda haja ndogo.
hypothesis: Njia nyingine zinazotegemea mzunguko wa mwili ni kunywa maji mengi (hasa maji au chai, dawa inayoweza kumfanya mtu apate mkojo) kabla ya kulala, na hivyo kumlazimisha mtu asimame ili aende kupiga mkojo.

source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
reference: Kiwango cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu humiliki huhusiana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo ndani ya mwili na roho yake.
hypothesis: Kiasi cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu anacho huambatana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo katika mwili na roho ya mtu.

source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
reference: Kadiri mvuto ulivyo chini, ndivyo nguvu za maisha zilizoko zilivyo chanya. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na kuridhika zaidi.
hypothesis: Kila mtu anaweza kupata amani na uradhi wa kweli.

source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
reference: Kila mtu anaweza kupata uelewa. Kitu kimoja kinachosimama njiani mwa lengo hili ni wasiwasi na uhasi wetu wenyewe.
hypothesis: Kila mtu anaweza kufikia ufahamu, lakini jambo pekee linalotukengeusha ni mkazo na uovu wetu.

source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
reference: Ubuddha wa Tibetani una msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini ulipanuliwa na njia ya mahayana ya upendo na mbinu nyingi za kutoka kwa Yoga ya India.
hypothesis: Ubuddha wa Tibet ni msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini walikuwa kupanuliwa na Mahayana njia ya upendo na kwa njia nyingi kutoka India Yoga.

source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
reference: Katika kanuni, Ubudha wa Kitibeti ni rahisi sana. Una Yoga ya Kundalini, kutafakari na njia ya upendo unaokumbatia yote.
hypothesis: Katika kanuni ya Tibetan Ubuddha ni rahisi sana. Ni linajumuisha Kundalini Yoga, kutafakari na njia ya upendo wote-kuzingatia.

source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
reference: Kupitia Yoga ya Kundalini, nguvu za Kundalini (nguvu za mwangaza) huibushwa kupitia mkao wa yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, urudiaji maneno au sauti na taswira.
hypothesis: Kwa Kundalini Yoga nishati ya Kundalini (nishati ya ufahamu) huamshwa kupitia nafasi za yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, mantras na visualizations.

source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
reference: Kitovu cha fikira za Tibet ni Yoga ya Uungu. Kupitia taswira ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati zinasafishwa, chakra zinaamilishwa na fahamu ya wongofu inaamshwa.
hypothesis: Kituo cha kutafakari Tibetan ni Deity Yoga. Kupitia visualization ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati ni kusafishwa, chakras ni kuamilishwa na ufahamu wa ufahamu ni kuundwa.

source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
reference: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, hivyo kupelekea ushirikiano wa USSR na Marekani. Kwa kumalizika kwa vita mgongano wa mfumo, mchakato na utamaduni vilipelekea kutengana kwa nchi.
hypothesis: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita Kuu ya 2, kusababisha ushirikiano kati ya USSR na Marekani.

source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
reference: Na miaka mbili ya kumalizika kwa vita, washirika wa zamani waligeuka kuwa maadui na Vita Baridi vikaanza.
hypothesis: Miaka miwili baada ya vita kwisha, washirika wa zamani walikuwa maadui na Vita Baridi ikaanza.

source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
reference: Ilikuwa idumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingepigwa kwa kweli na vikosi vya kiwakala, katika nyanja za vita toka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistani, Kuba na sehemu nyingine nyingi
hypothesis: Ilikuwa ya kudumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingekuwa kupigana kwa kweli, na askari wakala, katika maeneo ya vita kutoka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistan, Cuba na maeneo mengine mengi.

source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
reference: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Kipolishi ulivunjwa, na tumaini la pekee lilikuwa kurudi na kujipanga tena kwa darajakuu la Kiromania.
hypothesis: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Poland ulikuwa tayari umevunjwa, na tumaini pekee lilikuwa kuondoka na kujipanga upya kando ya kichwa cha daraja la Rumania.

source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
reference: Hata hivyo, mipango hii ilipitwa na wakati usiku mmoja, wakati zaidi ya askari 800,000 kutoka Jeshi Jekundu la Umoja wa Kisovyeti lilipoingia na kuunda mipaka ya Belarusiani na Ukreini baada ya kuvamia maeneo ya mashariki mwa Polandi kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mapatano ya Kisovyeti-Polishi Yasiyo ya Uchokozi, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, pande mbili na pande nyingi.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, mipango hiyo iliisha mara moja, wakati askari zaidi ya 800,000 kutoka Jeshi la Sovieti walipoingia na kuunda maeneo ya Belarus na Ukrainia baada ya kuvamia mikoa ya mashariki ya Poland kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mkataba wa Usishambulie wa Sovieti na Poland, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, ya pande mbili na nyingi.

source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
reference: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha halaiki ya watu na bidhaa nyingi baharini.
hypothesis: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa ni njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha watu na bidhaa nyingi katika bahari.

source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
reference: Kazi ya Jeshi la wanamaji kwa kiasili imekuwa ni kuhakikisha kuwa nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zako, wakati huo huo, kuzuia uwezo wa adui wako wa kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.
hypothesis: Kazi ya majeshi ya majini imekuwa kwa kawaida kuhakikisha kwamba nchi yako ina uwezo wa kuhamisha watu wako na bidhaa, wakati huo huo, kuingilia kati na uwezo wa adui yako ya kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.

source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
reference: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ya hivi karibuni ni kampeni ya Kaskazini mwa Atlantiki ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Waingereza.
hypothesis: Moja ya mifano ya hivi karibuni ya kuvutia ya hii ilikuwa kampeni ya Kaskazini ya Atlantiki ya WWII. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kuhamisha watu na vifaa kuvuka Bahari ya Atlantiki kusaidia Uingereza.

source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
reference: Wakati huo huo, askari wa majeshi ya Ujerumani, kwa kutumia nyambizi, yalikuwa yakijaribu kuzuia trafiki hii.
hypothesis: Wakati huohuo, jeshi la wanamaji la Ujerumani, likiwatumia mabaharia wa chini ya maji, lilijaribu kuzuia usafirishaji huo.

source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
reference: Ikiwa Muungano ungeshindwa, pengine Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama vile ilivyokuwa imeshinda Uropa.
hypothesis: Ikiwa Majeshi ya Muungano yangeshindwa, huenda Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama ilivyoshinda Ulaya yote.

source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
reference: Yaelekea mbuzi walianza kufugwa takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagrosi ya Irani.
hypothesis: Huenda mbuzi walianza kufugwa miaka 10,000 hivi iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagros huko Iran.

source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
reference: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwafuga kwa ufikiaji rahisi wa maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.
hypothesis: Utamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwaweka ili kupata maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.

source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
reference: Kijumla, mbuzi wa nyumbani walianza kufugwa kwa makundi yaliyotangatanga milimani au maeneo mengine ya malisho, huku yakisimamiwa na walinzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana wachanga, sawia na wachungaji wanaofahamika sana. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hata leo.
hypothesis: Mbuzi wa kufugwa kwa kawaida waliwekwa katika makundi yaliyotembea juu ya milima au maeneo mengine ya malisho, mara nyingi wakichukuliwa na wachungaji wa mbuzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana, sawa na mchungaji anayejulikana zaidi. Njia hizi za kuchunga bado zinatumika leo.

source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
