reference: Kwa kuwa Montevideo imo kusini mwa Ikweta, huko huwa ni msimu wa kiangazi wakati Nyanda ya Kaskazini ni baridi na kinyume chake.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa Montevideo iko kusini mwa Ikweta, ni wakati wa kiangazi huko wakati wa majira ya baridi kali katika Kizio cha Kaskazini na kinyume chake.

source: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
reference: Montevideo iko upande wa sabutropiki; katika miezi ya kiangazi, hali ya joto zaidi ya +30ºC ni hali ya kawaida.
hypothesis: Montevideo iko katika kitropiki; katika miezi ya kiangazi, joto la juu ya +30°C ni la kawaida.

source: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
reference: Msimu wa baridi unaweza kuwa baridi kidanganyifu: kadiri ya joto kwa mara chache sana huenda chini ya kiwango cha kugandisha, lakini upepo na unyevu huchanganyika na kufanya kuwe na baridi zaidi kuliko ile ambayo kipimajoto kinasema.
hypothesis: Majira ya baridi kali yanaweza kuwa yenye kuchosha sana: joto haliwezi kushuka chini ya sufuri, lakini upepo na unyevu huchanganya na kufanya hali iwe baridi kuliko vile kipima joto kinavyosema.

source: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
reference: Hakuna vipindi maalum vya “mvua” au “ukavu”: kiwango cha mvua hubaki takribani sawa mwaka mzima.
hypothesis: Hakuna majira ya "mvua" na "msitu" hususa: kiasi cha mvua hubaki sawa kwa mwaka mzima.

source: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
reference: Ingawa wanyama wengi mbugani wamezoea kuwaona wanadamu, kwa vyovyote wanyapori ni wa mwituni, wala hawastahili kulishwa au kusumbuliwa.
hypothesis: Ingawa wanyama wengi katika mbuga hiyo wamezoea kuwaona wanadamu, wanyama hao ni wa pori na hawapaswi kulishwa wala kusumbuliwa.

source: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
reference: Kwa mujibu wa usimamizi wa mbuga, kaa walau yadi/mita 100 mbali na dubu na mbwa mwitu na yadi/mita 25 kutoka kwa wanyama mwitu wengine wote!
hypothesis: Kulingana na mamlaka ya mbuga, kaa umbali wa meta 100 kutoka kwa dubu na mbwa mwitu na meta 25 kutoka kwa wanyama wengine wote wa pori!

source: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
reference: Haijalishi jinsi watulivu wanavyokaa, baisani, elki, kongoni, dubu, na karibu wanyama wote wakubwa wanaweza kushambulia.
hypothesis: Hata kama wanaonekana kuwa wanyenyekevu kadiri gani, nyati, kongoni, nyatisinga, dubu, na karibu wanyama wote wakubwa wanaweza kushambulia.

source: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
reference: Kila mwaka, dazeni za wageni huumia kwa sababu hawakuzingatia umbali unaofaa. Wanyama hawa ni wakubwa, wa mwitu, na uwezekano wa kuwa hatari, kwa hivyo wape nafasi yao.
hypothesis: Kila mwaka, wageni wengi hujeruhiwa kwa sababu hawakuwa na umbali unaofaa. Wanyama hao ni wakubwa, ni wa pori, na wanaweza kuwa hatari, kwa hiyo wapeni nafasi.

source: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
reference: Kwa kuongezea, fahamu kuwa harufu huwavutia dubu na wanyama wengine mwitu, kwa hivyo epuka kubeba au kupika vyakula vyenye harufu na utunze usafi kwenye kambi.
hypothesis: Pia, kumbuka kwamba harufu mbaya huvutia dubu na wanyama wengine wa pori, kwa hiyo epuka kubeba au kupika vyakula vyenye harufu mbaya na usafishe kambi.

source: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
reference: Apia ni mji mkuu wa Samoa. Mji huo uko kwenye kisiwa cha Upolu na lina watu chini ya 40,000.
hypothesis: Apia ni mji mkuu wa Samoa. Mji huo uko kwenye kisiwa cha Upolu na una wakazi wachache chini ya 40,000.

source: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
reference: Apia ilianzishwa miaka ya 1850 na imekuwa mji mkuu rasmi wa Samoa tangu 1959.
hypothesis: Apia ilianzishwa katika miaka ya 1850 na imekuwa mji mkuu rasmi wa Samoa tangu 1959.

source: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
reference: Bandari ilikuwa sehemu ya kutokabiliana maarufu kwa nevi mnamo 1889 wakati meli saba kutoka Ujerumani, Marekani na Uingereza zilikataa kuondoka kwenye bandari.
hypothesis: Bandari hiyo ilikuwa mahali pa mapigano ya kijeshi ya mwaka wa 1889 wakati meli saba kutoka Ujerumani, Marekani, na Uingereza zilipokataa kuondoka bandari hiyo.

source: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
reference: Meli zote zilizamishwa, isipokuwa meli moja ya Uingereza. Karibu maisha 200 ya Wamarekani na Wajerumani yalipotea.
hypothesis: Meli zote zilizama, isipokuwa meli moja ya Uingereza, na karibu watu 200 wa Marekani na Ujerumani walikufa.

source: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
reference: Wakati wa mapambano ya uhuru yaliyoandaliwa na harakati ya Mau, mkutano wa amani mjini ulisababisha mauaji ya chifu mkuu Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
hypothesis: Wakati wa mapambano ya uhuru yaliyoandaliwa na harakati za Mau, mkutano wa amani katika mji huo ulisababisha kuuawa kwa kiongozi mkuu Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
reference: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana na kukaliwa magamaga kwa kwa bandari mbili na Auckland. Maarufu zaidi ziko katika sehemu tatu.
hypothesis: Kuna fukwe nyingi, kutokana na Auckland ya straddling bandari mbili. maarufu zaidi ni katika maeneo matatu.

source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
reference: Fukwe za pwani ya Kaskazini (katika wilaya ya Kaskazini mwa Bandari) ziko kwenye Bahari ya Pasifiki na zinyooka kutoka Long Bay kaskazini hadi Devonport kusini.
hypothesis: North Shore fukwe (katika wilaya ya North Harbour) ni juu ya Bahari ya Pasifiki na kuenea kutoka Long Bay kaskazini kwa Devonport kusini.

source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
reference: Karibu fukwe zote ni za mchanga na uogeleaji salama na nyingi yake huwa na kivuli chini ya miti ya pohutukawa.
hypothesis: Karibu wote ni fuo zenye mchanga na salama kuogelea, na wengi wana kivuli cha miti ya pohutukawa.

source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
reference: Pwani za Tamaki Drive ziko katika Bandari ya Waitemata, kwenye maeneo ya kifahari ya Mission Bay na St. Heliers katika Auckland ya Kati.
hypothesis: Fukwe za Tamaki Drive ziko kwenye Bandari ya Waitemata, katika vitongoji vya kifahari vya Mission Bay na St Heliers huko Auckland ya Kati.

source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
reference: Hizi ni pwani za kifamilia ambazo wakati mwingine hujaa watu, zilizo na masafa ya maduka katika ufuo. Uogeleaji ni salama.
hypothesis: Hizi ni fukwe za familia zenye watu wengi nyakati nyingine na maduka mengi yaliyo kando ya ufuo. Kuogelea ni salama.

source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
reference: Bia kuu katika eneo ni ‘Number One’, sio bia tata, ila ni zuri na hufariji. Hio bia nyingine ya mtaa huitwa ‘Manta’.
hypothesis: Bia kuu ya ndani ni 'Nambari Moja', sio bia ngumu, lakini ni ya kupendeza na ya kuburudisha. Bia nyingine ya ndani inaitwa "Manta".

source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
reference: Kuna aina nyingi za mvinyo wa Kifaransa inavyopatikana, lakini mvinyo wa New Zealand na Australia waweza safiri bora.
hypothesis: Kuna divai nyingi za Ufaransa, lakini divai za New Zealand na Australia huenda zikafanya safari nzuri zaidi.

source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
reference: Maji ya ndani ya bomba ni salama kabisa kwa kunywa, lakini maji ya chupa ni rahisi kupata iwapo una hofu.
hypothesis: Maji ya bomba ya huko ni salama kabisa kunywa, lakini ni rahisi kupata maji ya chupa ikiwa unaogopa.

source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
reference: Kwa Waaustralia, wazo la kahawa ‘nyeupe’ ni la kigeni. Nyeusi fupi ni ’espresso’, cappuccino inakuja imerundikwa zaidi na malai (si povu) na chai inaandaliwa bila maziwa.
hypothesis: Kwa Waustralia, wazo la kahawa 'nyeupe nyeupe' ni la kigeni. Nyeusi fupi ni 'espresso', cappuccino huja na cream nyingi (sio povu), na chai hutolewa bila maziwa.

source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
reference: Kinywaji moto cha chokoleti kinafikia viwango vya Ubelgiji. Sharubati za matunda ni bei ghali lakini ni bora.
hypothesis: Chokoleti moto ni kwa viwango vya Ubelgiji. Mchuzi wa matunda ni ghali lakini bora.

source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
reference: Safari nyingi kwenye mwamba hufanywa mwaka mzima, na majeraha kutokana na sababu yoyote baina ya hizi katika mwamba ni nadra.
hypothesis: Safari nyingi za kwenda kwenye miamba hufanywa mwaka mzima, na majeraha yanayosababishwa na yoyote kati ya sababu hizo kwenye miamba ni nadra.

source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
reference: Bado, chukua ushauri kutoka kwa mamlaka, utii ishara zote, na umakinikie maonyo ya usalama.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, sikiliza mashauri ya wenye mamlaka, tii ishara zote, na usikilize kwa makini maonyo ya usalama.

source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
reference: Viwavi wa baharini hutokea karibu na pwani na karibu na midomo ya mto kuanzia Oktoba hadi Aprili kaskazini mwa 1770. Wakati mwingine huenda wakapatikana nje ya nyakati hizi.
hypothesis: Kondoo wa sanduku huonekana karibu na fuo za mito na pwani kuanzia Oktoba hadi Aprili kaskazini mwa mwaka wa 1770.

source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
reference: Papa wapo, ingawa ni nadra kwao kuwashambulia binadamu. Papa wengi huwaogopa wanadamu na huogelea mbali.
hypothesis: Kuna papa, hata hivyo wao mara chache kushambulia watu. papa wengi ni hofu ya binadamu na bila shaka kuogelea mbali.

source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
reference: Mamba wa majichumvi hawaishi sana baharini, kwani makazi yao ya kimsingi ni milango ya mito kaskazini mwa Rokihamptoni.
hypothesis: Mamba ya maji ya chumvi hayaishi baharini, makao yao makuu ni katika vijito vya mito kaskazini mwa Rockhampton.

source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
reference: Kuhifadhi mapema humpatia msafiri amani ya akili kwamba atapata mahali pa kulala atakapofika.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa mtu huweka nafasi mapema, anaweza kuwa na uhakika kwamba atapata mahali pa kulala atakapofika.

source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
reference: Kampuni za uwakala wa usafiri mara nyingi huwa na ofa na hoteli maalum, ingawa unaweza kupata uwezekano wa kuhifadhi aina nyingine za malazi, kama mahali pa kupiga kambi, kupitia wakala wa usafiri.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi mawakala wa kusafiri hufanya mikataba na hoteli fulani, ingawa huenda ukaona inawezekana kuandaa aina nyingine za malazi, kama vile maeneo ya kambi, kupitia mawakala wa kusafiri.

source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
reference: Kampuni za wakala wa usafiri kwa kawaida hutoa vifurushi vya ofa ambavyo hujumuisha kiamshakinywa, mipango ya uchukuzi kwenda/kutoka kwenye uwanja wa ndege au hata vifurushi vya ndege na hoteli vilivyochanganywa.
hypothesis: Biashara za kusafiri kwa kawaida hutoa vifurushi ambavyo vinajumuisha kifungua kinywa, mipango ya usafiri kwenda / kutoka uwanja wa ndege au hata ndege na hoteli zilizopangwa.

source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
reference: Pia wanaweza kukuwekea uhifadhi iwapo unahitaji muda wa kufikiria kuhusu ofa hiyo au kupata hati nyingine za mahali unapokwenda (k.m. visa).
hypothesis: Pia wanaweza kuweka nafasi kwa ajili yenu kama unahitaji muda wa kufikiri juu ya kutoa au kupata nyaraka nyingine kwa ajili ya marudio yako (kwa mfano visa).

source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
reference: Marekebisho au maombi yoyote lazima yafuatwe kupitia wakala wa kusafiri kwanza na si moja kwa moja na hoteli.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, marekebisho au maombi yoyote yanapaswa kupitishwa kwanza kupitia wakala wa kusafiri na si moja kwa moja na hoteli.

source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
reference: Kwa baadhi ya tamasha, idadi kubwa ya wanaohudhuria tamasha za muziki huamua kukita kambi kwenye eneo, na wengi wao hukuchukulia kuwa sehemu muhimu ya tajriba hiyo.
hypothesis: Kwa ajili ya sherehe fulani, wengi wa wahudhuriaji wa sherehe za muziki huamua kupiga kambi mahali hapo, na wahudhuriaji wengi huona kuwa sehemu muhimu ya ono hilo.

source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
reference: Ikiwa ungetaka kuwa karibu na matukio utahitajika kurauka mapema ili upate eneo la kukita kambi karibu na muziki.
hypothesis: Kama unataka kuwa karibu na hatua wewe ni kwenda kuwa na kupata mapema kupata kambi karibu na muziki.

source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
reference: Kumbuka kuwa hata muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu ukimalizika, kunaweza kuwa na sehemu za tamasha ambazo zitaendelea kucheza muziki hadi usiku wa manane.
hypothesis: Kumbuka kwamba hata ingawa muziki kwenye jukwaa kuu huenda umekwisha, huenda sehemu fulani za sherehe zikaendelea kucheza muziki hadi usiku sana.

source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
reference: Tamasha kadhaa zina maeneo maalumu ya kukita kambi kwa familia zenye watoto wadogo.
hypothesis: Sherehe fulani huwa na maeneo ya pekee ya kambi kwa ajili ya familia zilizo na watoto wadogo.

source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
reference: Kama unavuka Northern Baltic katika msimu wa baridi, kagua eneo la kibanda, kwani kupita katika theluji husababisha kelele mbaya kwa wale wanaoathirika zaidi.
hypothesis: Ikiwa unavuka Bahari ya Baltiki Kaskazini wakati wa majira ya baridi, chunguza mahali ambapo cabin iko, kwa kuwa kupita kwenye barafu husababisha kelele mbaya sana kwa wale walioathiriwa zaidi.

source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
reference: Safari za baharini za Mtakatifu Petersburge hujumuisha muda wa mjini. Abiria hawa wameepushwa na mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).
hypothesis: Saint Petersburg cruises ni pamoja na muda katika mji. abiria cruise ni msamaha wa mahitaji ya visa (angalia masharti).

source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
reference: Makasino kwa kawaida hufanya juhudi nyingi ili kuongeza pesa na muda unaotumika na wacheza kamari. Madirisha na saa kwa kawaida huwa hazipo na mlango wa kutoka huwa mgumu kupata.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kasinon hujitahidi sana kutumia wakati na pesa kwa kadiri iwezekanavyo ili wageni watumie pesa nyingi.

source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
reference: Aghalabu huwa na chakula cha kipekee, vinywaji na matoleo ya burdani, ili kuwatumbuiza wageni na kuwatunza katika majengo yao.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida wao kuwa na chakula maalum, vinywaji na burudani inatoa, kuweka wageni katika mood nzuri, na kuwaweka katika eneo.

source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
reference: Baadhi ya kumbi hutoa vileo ndani ya nyumba. Hata hivyo, ulevi hutatiza maamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wazuri wanajua umuhimu wa kuwa watulivu.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, ulevi huathiri uwezo wa mtu wa kufanya maamuzi, na wacheza kamari wote wanaojua kucheza kamari wanajua umuhimu wa kuendelea kuwa na kiasi.

source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
reference: Yeyote ambaye atakuwa akiendesha gari maeneo yaliyoinuka au vijia vya milimani anastahili kuzingatia uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, na baridi kali.
hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayesubiri kuendesha gari katika eneo lenye latitudo za juu au kwenye milima anapaswa kufikiria uwezekano wa theluji, barafu, au joto la chini ya sufuri.

source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
reference: Katika barabara zenye barafu na theluji, msuguano uko chini na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko katika lami tupu.
hypothesis: Kwenye barabara zenye barafu na theluji, hakuna msuguano mwingi na huwezi kuendesha gari kana kwamba uko kwenye lami tupu.

source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
reference: Wakati wa barafu nyingi, barafu ya kutosha kukufanya ukwame inaweza kuanguka kwa muda mfupi.
hypothesis: Wakati wa dhoruba za theluji, theluji nyingi sana zinaweza kuanguka kwa muda mfupi sana.

source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
reference: Mwonekano unaweza pia kuzuiliwa kupitia kwa kuanguka au kuvumisha theluji au kwa mtonesho au barafu kwenye madirisha ya magari.
hypothesis: Maoni pia inaweza kuwa mdogo kwa kuanguka au kuvuma theluji au kwa condensation au barafu kwenye madirisha ya magari.

source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
reference: Kwa upande mwingine, mazingira ya theluji na barafu ni ya kawaida katika mataifa mengi, na uchukuzi huendelea mwaka mzima bila kutatizwa.
hypothesis: Kwa upande mwingine, baridi na theluji ni jambo la kawaida katika nchi nyingi, na magari huendeshwa bila kukatizwa mwaka mzima.

source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
reference: Pengine safari ndizo kivutio kikubwa zaidi cha watalii katika Afrika na angazio la wageni wengi.
hypothesis: Safari labda ndizo huvutia watalii wengi zaidi barani Afrika na ni jambo kuu kwa wageni wengi.

source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
reference: Neno safari linamaanisha kusafiri kuona Wanyama wa pori wa Afrika wanaoshangaza, haswa kwenye savanna
hypothesis: Neno safari linalotumiwa sana linarejelea safari za nchi kavu ili kuona wanyama wa pori barani Afrika, hasa kwenye nyanda za msituni.

source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
reference: Baadhi ya wanyama, kama vile ndovu na twiga, huelekea kusogea kukaribia magari na vifaa vya kawaida vitaruhusu utazamaji mwema.
hypothesis: Wanyama fulani, kama vile tembo na nondo, huwa karibu na magari na vifaa vya kawaida huwezesha kuona vizuri.

source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
reference: Simba, duma na chui wakati mwingine huwa na aibu na utawaona bora na darubini.
hypothesis: Simba, cheetahs na chui wakati mwingine ni aibu na wewe kuwaona vizuri zaidi na darubini.

source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
reference: Safari ya miguu (ijulikanayo kama "matembezi kichakani", "safari ya kukwea", au kwenda "kwa miguu") hujumuisha ukweaji, iwe kwa saa chache au siku kadhaa.
hypothesis: Safari ya kutembea (pia inaitwa "kutembea kwenye misitu", "kutembea safari", au kwenda "kutembea") inajumuisha kutembea, ama kwa masaa machache au siku kadhaa.

source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
reference: Mbio za Walemavu zitaanza mnamo Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021. Baadhi ya mashindano yatafanyika katika maeneo tofauti tofauti kote Japani.
hypothesis: Michezo ya Paralympics itafanyika kuanzia Agosti 24 hadi Septemba 5, 2021.

source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
reference: Tokyo itakuwa mji wa kipekee wa Asia kuwahi kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki mbili za kiangazi, kwani ilikuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo mnamo 1964.
hypothesis: Tokyo itakuwa jiji pekee la Asia ambalo limekaribisha michezo miwili ya Olimpiki ya majira ya joto, baada ya kuwa mwenyeji wa michezo hiyo mwaka wa 1964.

source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
reference: Ikiwa ulihifadhi nafasi ya ndege na malazi yako 2020 kabla ya uahirisho kutangazwa, unaweza kuwa na hali ya hila.
hypothesis: Ikiwa umeweka nafasi za ndege na malazi yako ya mwaka 2020 kabla ya kuahirishwa, huenda ukawa na tatizo.

source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
reference: Sera za kufuta zinatofautiana, lakini kufikia mwishoni mwa mwezi Machi sera nyingi za ughairi kwa sababu ya virusi vya korona hazifiki hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki ilikuwa imeratibiwa.
hypothesis: Sera za kughairi zinatofautiana, lakini kufikia mwishoni mwa Machi sera nyingi za kughairi zinazohusiana na virusi vya corona haziongezewi hadi Julai 2020, wakati Olimpiki zilipokuwa zimepangwa.

source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
reference: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi nyingi za hafla zitagharimu kati ya Yeni 2,500 na Yeni 130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zikigharimu takriban Yeni 7,000.
hypothesis: Inatarajiwa kwamba tiketi za matukio mengi zitagharimu kati ya ¥2,500 na ¥130,000, na tiketi za kawaida zina gharama ya ¥7,000.

source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
reference: Kupiga pasi nguo zilizo na maji kunaweza kuzisaidia kukauka. Hoteli nyingi zina pasi na bodi za kupigia pasi za kukodisha, hata kama mtu hayuko ndani ya chumba hicho.
hypothesis: Kuweka nguo zenye unyevu kwenye vyuma kunaweza kuwasaidia kukauka. Hoteli nyingi zina vifaa vya kuwekea vyuma na mbao za kuwekea vyuma vinavyopatikana kwa ajili ya kukopesha, hata ikiwa hakuna vifaa hivyo kwenye chumba.

source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
reference: Ikiwa pasi haipatikani, au ikiwa hupendii kuvaa soksi zilizopasiwa, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kikaushi nywele, ikiwa kinapatikana.
hypothesis: Ikiwa hakuna chuma cha chuma, au ikiwa hupendi kuvaa soksi zilizowekwa chuma, basi unaweza kujaribu kutumia kifaa cha kukausha nywele, ikiwa kinapatikana.

source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
reference: Uwe mwangalifu kitambaa kisiwe moto sana (kwani inaweza kusababisha urukaji, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kuchoma).
hypothesis: Uwe mwangalifu ili kitambaa kisiwe na joto sana (ambalo linaweza kusababisha kukunjamana, au katika hali mbaya zaidi, kuchomwa).

source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
reference: Kuna njia tofauti za kusafisha maji, baadhi zikiwa na mafanikio dhidi ya vitishio maalum.
hypothesis: Kuna njia mbalimbali za kusafisha maji, baadhi yake zikiwa na matokeo zaidi dhidi ya hatari fulani.

source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
reference: Katika baadhi ya maeneo mengine kuchemsha maji kwa dakika moja kunatosha, kwingineko dakika kadhaa zitahitajika.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo fulani kuoka maji kwa dakika moja kunatosha, katika mengine dakika kadhaa zinahitajiwa.

source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
reference: Vichujio hutofautiana katika utendaji, na iwapo utapatwa na wasiwasi, basi unafaa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kabisa kutoka kwa kampuni tajika.
hypothesis: Vichungi hutofautiana kwa kufaa, na ikiwa una wasiwasi, basi unapaswa kufikiria kununua maji yako katika chupa iliyofungwa kutoka kwa kampuni yenye sifa nzuri.

source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
reference: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawawatambui kutoka maeneo yao ya nyumbani.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanaweza kukutana na wadudu wa wanyama ambao hawawajui katika maeneo yao.

source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
reference: Wadudu waharibifu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha maudhi, au katika hali mbaya kusababisha athari za mzio, kueneza sumu au kusambaza maambukizi.
hypothesis: Wadudu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kukitia uchungu, au hata zaidi, wanaweza kusababisha mzio, kueneza sumu, au kuambukiza magonjwa.

source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
reference: Maradhi yenyewe ya kuambukiza, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawahitimu kama wanyama-vipenzi.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida magonjwa yenye kuambukiza yenyewe, au wanyama hatari wanaoweza kuumiza au kuua watu kwa nguvu, hawastahili kuwa wadudu.

source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
reference: Ununuzi bila ushuru ni nafasi ya kununua bidhaa zisizo na ushuru na kodi katika maeneo fulani.
hypothesis: Ununuzi wa vitu bila ushuru ni fursa ya kununua bidhaa ambazo hazitozwi kodi na ushuru wa bidhaa za kienyeji katika maeneo fulani.

source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
reference: Wasafiri katika nchi zinazotoza ushuru wa juu wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa kiwango kikubwa cha pesa, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vinywaji vyenye vileo na tumbaku.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanaokwenda nchi zenye kodi nzito nyakati nyingine wanaweza kuokoa pesa nyingi, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vile vinywaji vyenye alkoholi na tumbaku.

source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
reference: Eneo katikati mwa Point Marion na Fairmont hutoa hali za uendeshaji gari zenye changamoto zaidi katika Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, inayopitia mara kwa mara kwenye maeneo ya ardhi yaliyo katika misitu iliyotengwa.
hypothesis: Sehemu ya kati ya Point Marion na Fairmont ina hali ngumu zaidi ya kuendesha gari kwenye Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, mara nyingi hupita kupitia eneo la misitu ya mbali.

source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
reference: Kama hujazoea kuendesha gari katika barabara za mashambani, kaa chonjo: miinuko mikali, njia nyembamba, na na pembe kali zimejaa.
hypothesis: Ikiwa hujazoea kuendesha gari barabarani, uwe mwangalifu: barabara zenye miamba, barabara nyembamba, na pembe za mviringo huwa nyingi.

source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
reference: Viwango vya kasi vilivyotumwa viko chini kabisa kuliko vya sehemu za zamani na zilizofuata — kawaida maili 35-40 kwa saa (kilomita 56-64 kwa saa) — na utii mkali kwavyo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.
hypothesis: Vipimo vya kasi vilivyowekwa ni chini sana kuliko katika sehemu zilizopita na zifuatazo  kawaida 35-40 mph (56-64 km / h)  na utii mkali kwao ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.

source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
reference: Cha kushangaza hata hivyo, huduma ya simu ya rununu ina nguvu sana hapa kuliko tandaa zingine za njia kama Pennsylvania Wilds.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, jambo la kushangaza ni kwamba, simu za mkononi zinawasiliana kwa urahisi zaidi kuliko sehemu nyinginezo za njia hiyo, kama vile sehemu za Pennsylvania Wilds.

source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
reference: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.
hypothesis: Vyakula vya keki vya Ujerumani ni vizuri sana, na huko Bavaria, ni vyenye wingi na vyenye aina mbalimbali, kama vile vya Austria, jirani yao ya kusini.

source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
reference: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.
hypothesis: Vyakula vya matunda ni vya kawaida, na maapulo hupikwa mwaka mzima, na cherries na plums huonekana wakati wa kiangazi.

source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
reference: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.
hypothesis: Pia, keki nyingi za Ujerumani zina almond, karanga, na njugu nyinginezo.

source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
reference: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.
hypothesis: Kama unataka baadhi ya pastries ndogo lakini tajiri, kujaribu nini kulingana na mkoa kuitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.

source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
reference: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.
hypothesis: Curry ni sahani inayotokana na mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.

source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
reference: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.
hypothesis: Curry inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "unyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.

source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
reference: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo ya ndani ya India Kaskazini na Pakistan, yogurt hutumiwa kwa kawaida katika curries; katika India Kusini na baadhi ya mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa kwa kawaida.

source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
reference: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.
hypothesis: Kwa kuwa kuna visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, vyakula vya Indonesia ni neno la kawaida linalohusu vyakula mbalimbali vya mikoa vinavyopatikana nchini kote.

source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
reference: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.
hypothesis: Lakini, ikitumiwa bila sifa zaidi, neno hilo huwa na maana ya chakula asili kutoka sehemu za kati na mashariki ya kisiwa kuu cha Java.

source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
reference: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.
hypothesis: Sasa inapatikana sana katika visiwa vyote, vyakula vya Kijava vina safu ya sahani za majira tu, ladha kuu ya Kijava ni karanga, pilipili, sukari (haswa sukari ya nazi ya Kijava) na viungo mbalimbali vya harufu nzuri.

source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
reference: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning’inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.
hypothesis: Vipande vya kuegesha farasi ni msaada kwa miguu ya mpanda farasi ambayo hutegemea upande mmoja wa kiti.

source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
reference: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.
hypothesis: Wao kutoa utulivu zaidi kwa ajili ya mpanda lakini inaweza kuwa na wasiwasi usalama kutokana na uwezekano wa miguu ya mpanda kupata kukwama katika yao.

source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
reference: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.
hypothesis: Ikiwa mpanda farasi ametupwa chini lakini mguu wake umenaswa kwenye mto, huenda akavutwa na farasi huyo anapokimbia.

source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
reference: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.
hypothesis: Kwanza, wapanda-farasi wengi huvaa viatu vyenye visigino vyenye nyayo na nyayo laini, nyembamba.

source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
reference: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.
hypothesis: Kisha, baadhi ya viti, hasa vile vya Kiingereza, vina vifungo vya usalama vinavyowezesha ngozi ya kiunzi kuanguka kutoka kwenye viti ikiwa inavutwa nyuma na mpanda-farasi anayeanguka.

source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
reference: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.
hypothesis: Bonde la Cochamó - eneo kuu la kupanda milima nchini Chile, linalojulikana kama Yosemite ya Amerika Kusini, lenye kuta kubwa za graniti na miamba.

source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
reference: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.
hypothesis: Watu wanaopanda milima kutoka sehemu zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kutengeneza njia mpya kati ya kuta zake zisizo na mwisho.

source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
reference: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.
hypothesis: Michezo ya theluji ya kushuka mlima, ambayo inatia ndani kuteleza kwenye theluji na kupiga mbizi kwenye theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza kwenye eneo lenye theluji kwa kutumia skis au ubao wa theluji uliofungwa miguuni.

source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
reference: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.
hypothesis: Skiing ni shughuli kubwa kusafiri na wapenzi wengi, wakati mwingine inajulikana kama "ski wavulana", mipango likizo nzima karibu skiing katika eneo fulani.

source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
reference: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!
hypothesis: Wazo la skiing ni ya zamani sana  mapambo ya pango kuonyesha skiers tarehe nyuma kama mbali kama 5000 BC!

source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
reference: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.
hypothesis: Kuteleza kwa theluji kwa njia ya mlima kama mchezo kulianza angalau katika karne ya 17, na mwaka wa 1861 watu wa Norway walifungua klabu ya kwanza ya kuteleza kwa ajili ya burudani huko Australia.

source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
reference: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.
hypothesis: Backpacking kwa skia: Shughuli hii pia inaitwa backcountry ski, ski ziara au ski hiking.

source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
reference: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.
hypothesis: Ni kuhusiana na lakini kwa kawaida haina kuhusisha alpine style ski touring au mlima, mwisho kufanyika katika mteremko mkali na kuhitaji mengi rigid skis na buti.

source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
reference: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.
hypothesis: Fikiria njia ya kuteleza kwenye theluji kuwa njia ya kutembea kwa miguu.

source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
reference: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.
hypothesis: Katika hali nzuri unaweza kufikia umbali mrefu zaidi kuliko kutembea  lakini ni mara chache sana utaweza kufikia kasi ya skiing bila mkoba mzito katika njia zilizopangwa.

source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
reference: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.
hypothesis: Ulaya ni bara ambalo ni dogo lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kupitia maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara kadhaa.

source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
reference: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, eneo la Schengen hufanya kazi kama nchi moja katika suala hili.

source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
reference: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, unapoendelea kukaa katika eneo hilo, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia vituo vya kukagua pasipoti tena.

source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
reference: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.
hypothesis: Vivyo hivyo, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huna haja ya kuomba visa kwa kila nchi mwanachama wa Schengen tofauti, hivyo kuokoa muda, fedha na karatasi.

source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
reference: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.
hypothesis: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kimataifa wa vitu vilivyotengenezwa kuwa vitu vya kale. Mashirika fulani ya kodi hufafanua bidhaa za zamani zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa vitu vya kale.

source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
reference: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.
hypothesis: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Amerika Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.

source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
reference: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.
hypothesis: Bidhaa za mikono zinaweza kufafanuliwa kuwa vitu vya kale, ingawa ni vipya kuliko bidhaa zinazozalishwa kwa wingi.

source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
reference: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.
hypothesis: Ufugaji wa shomoro ni njia muhimu ya kupata riziki miongoni mwa Wasami na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi wenye kazi nyingine.

source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
reference: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hata kwa jadi, sio Wasami wote wamehusika katika ufugaji wa nyani kwa kiwango kikubwa, lakini waliishi kutokana na uvuvi, uwindaji na kadhalika, na nyani kwa ujumla kama wanyama wa kuchimba.

source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
reference: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.
hypothesis: Leo Wasami wengi hufanya kazi za kisasa. Utalii ni mapato muhimu katika eneo la Wasami la Sápmi.

source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
reference: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.
hypothesis: Ingawa hutumiwa sana, hasa miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Gypsy" mara nyingi huonwa kuwa la kukera kwa sababu ya uhusiano wake na mitazamo mibaya na maoni yasiyo sahihi kuhusu Waromani.

source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
reference: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.
hypothesis: Ikiwa nchi ambayo utatembelea inakuwa chini ya ushauri wa kusafiri, bima yako ya afya ya kusafiri au bima ya kughairi safari inaweza kuathiriwa.

source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
reference: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.
hypothesis: Huenda pia ukataka kutafuta ushauri kutoka kwa serikali nyingine, lakini ushauri wao umekusudiwa raia wao.

source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
reference: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.
hypothesis: Kwa mfano, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati wanaweza kukabili hali tofauti na za Wazungu au Waarabu.

source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
reference: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.
hypothesis: Mashauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi fulani.

source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
reference: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.
hypothesis: Maoni yaliyowasilishwa mara nyingi ni ya kijuu-juu, ya jumla na rahisi sana ikilinganishwa na habari za kina zaidi zinazopatikana mahali pengine.

source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
reference: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.
hypothesis: Hali mbaya ya hewa ni neno la jumla kwa hali yoyote ya hewa hatari ambayo inaweza kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupoteza maisha ya binadamu.

source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
reference: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.
hypothesis: Hali mbaya ya hewa inaweza kutokea mahali popote ulimwenguni, na kuna aina tofauti za hali hiyo, ambayo inaweza kutegemea jiografia, jiografia, na hali ya anga.

source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
reference: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.
hypothesis: Pepo kali, mvua ya mawe, mvua nyingi, na moto wa misitu ni aina na matokeo ya hali mbaya ya hewa, kama vile ngurumo, vimbunga, maji, na vimbunga.

source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
reference: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.
hypothesis: Hali mbaya za hali ya hewa za kikanda na za msimu ni pamoja na dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.

source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
reference: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanashauriwa sana kuwa na ufahamu wa hatari yoyote ya hali mbaya ya hewa inayoathiri eneo lao kwani inaweza kuathiri mipango yoyote ya kusafiri.

source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
reference: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.
hypothesis: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inaweza kuonwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mazoezi ya kitaalamu.

source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
reference: Utafutaji wa ‘Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama’ kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.
hypothesis: Utafutaji wa Intaneti kwa ajili ya 'Hostile environment course' labda utatoa anwani ya kampuni ya ndani.

source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, somo hilo huzungumzia mambo yote yaliyozungumziwa hapa kwa undani zaidi, na kwa kawaida linahusisha uzoefu wa kazi.

source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.
hypothesis: Kozi kawaida itakuwa kutoka siku 2-5 na itakuwa kuhusisha kucheza jukumu, mengi ya misaada ya kwanza na wakati mwingine silaha mafunzo.

source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
reference: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.
hypothesis: Vitabu na magazeti yanayozungumzia kuokoka katika maeneo ya pori ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayozungumzia maeneo ya vita ni machache.

source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
reference: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.
hypothesis: Wasafiri wanaopanga kufanya upasuaji wa kubadili jinsia nje ya nchi wanapaswa kuhakikisha kwamba wana hati halali za safari ya kurudi.

source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
reference: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.
hypothesis: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti na jinsia isiyoelezwa (X) au nyaraka zilizoboreshwa ili kufanana na jina na jinsia inayotakiwa hutofautiana.

source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
reference: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.
hypothesis: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kuheshimu hati hizi ni tofauti sana.

source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
reference: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.
hypothesis: Mapitio ya vituo vya usalama pia yamekuwa yenye kuingilia mambo mengi zaidi katika enzi ya baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.

source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
reference: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.
hypothesis: Watu wa jinsia tofauti kabla ya upasuaji hawapaswi kutarajia kupitia skanners na faragha na hadhi yao bila kuharibika.

source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
reference: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.
hypothesis: Mikondo ya kuvunja ni mtiririko wa kurudi kutoka kwa mawimbi yanayovunja pwani, mara nyingi kwenye mwamba au kitu kama hicho.

source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
reference: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.
hypothesis: Kutokana na topolojia ya chini ya maji mtiririko wa kurudi ni umakini katika sehemu chache kina, na sasa haraka kwa maji ya kina inaweza kuundwa huko.

source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
reference: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.
hypothesis: Watu wengi hufa kwa sababu ya uchovu wanapojaribu kuogelea kinyume cha mkondo, jambo ambalo huenda lisiwezekane.

source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
reference: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.
hypothesis: Mara tu unapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si vigumu kuliko kawaida.

source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
reference: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.
hypothesis: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutapata kukamatwa tena au, ikitegemea ustadi wako na kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokolewe.

source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
reference: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.
hypothesis: Mshtuko wa kurudi huja mapema kuliko mshtuko wa utamaduni (kuna hatua ndogo ya mwezi wa harusi), hudumu kwa muda mrefu zaidi, na inaweza kuwa kali zaidi.

source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
reference: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.
hypothesis: Watu wanaosafiri ambao walizoea utamaduni mpya kwa urahisi nyakati nyingine huona ni vigumu sana kuzoea utamaduni wao.

source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
reference: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.
hypothesis: Unaporudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi nje ya nchi, umejirekebisha na utamaduni mpya na umepoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.

source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
reference: Wakati ulienda ng’ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.
hypothesis: Ulipokuwa ukihamia nchi nyingine, huenda watu walikuwa wastahimilivu na wenye kuelewa, wakijua kwamba wasafiri katika nchi mpya wanahitaji kuzoea hali.

source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
reference: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.
hypothesis: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba subira na uelewevu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.

source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
reference: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.
hypothesis: Piramidi sauti na mwanga show ni moja ya mambo ya kuvutia zaidi katika eneo kwa ajili ya watoto.

source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
reference: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.
hypothesis: Unaweza kuona piramidi katika giza na unaweza kuona yao katika ukimya kabla ya show kuanza.

source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
reference: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida wewe daima kusikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama tu kitabu hadithi.

source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
reference: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.
hypothesis: Sphinx ni kuweka kama background na msimuliaji wa hadithi ndefu.

source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
reference: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.
hypothesis: Mandhari zinaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti zinaangazwa.

source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
reference: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.
hypothesis: Visiwa vya Shetland Kusini, vilivyogunduliwa mwaka 1819, vinadaiwa na mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, na kumi na sita zinafanya kazi mnamo 2020.

source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
reference: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.
hypothesis: visiwa iko 120 km kaskazini ya Peninsula. kubwa ni King George Island na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.

source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
reference: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.
hypothesis: Visiwa vingine ni kisiwa cha Livingston, na Deception ambako volkano iliyojaa maji ambayo bado inaendelea kuwaka hutoa bandari nzuri sana.

source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
reference: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.
hypothesis: Ellsworth Land ni eneo la kusini mwa Peninsula, iliyofungwa na Bahari ya Bellingshausen.

source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
reference: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.
hypothesis: Milima ya Peninsula hapa huungana katika nyanda, kisha hujitokeza tena ili kuunda safu ya kilometa 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, iliyogawanywa na Glasi ya Minnesota.

source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
reference: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.
hypothesis: Sehemu ya kaskazini au Sentinel Range ina milima ya juu zaidi ya Antarctica, Vinson Massif, ikifikia kilele cha 4892 m Mount Vinson.

source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
reference: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.
hypothesis: Katika maeneo ya mbali, bila simu ya mkononi, simu ya setilaiti yaweza kuwa chaguo lako pekee.

source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
reference: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.
hypothesis: Simu ya setilaiti kwa kawaida haibadiliki simu ya mkononi, kwa kuwa ni lazima uwe nje na kuona vizuri setilaiti ili kupiga simu.

source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
reference: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.
hypothesis: Huduma hiyo hutumiwa mara kwa mara na meli, ikiwa ni pamoja na mashua za burudani, pamoja na safari ambazo zina data ya mbali na mahitaji ya sauti.

source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
reference: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.
hypothesis: Mtoa huduma wako wa simu wa eneo hilo anaweza kukupa habari zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kuungana na huduma hii.

source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
reference: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.
hypothesis: Chaguo linalozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga mwaka wa ziada ni kusafiri na kujifunza.

source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
reference: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.
hypothesis: Jambo hilo ni la kawaida hasa kwa wanaomaliza shule, kwa kuwa hilo huwawezesha kuchukua mwaka mmoja kabla ya kwenda chuo kikuu, bila kuhatarisha elimu yao.

source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
reference: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.
hypothesis: Katika visa vingi, kujiandikisha katika kozi ya mwaka wa mapumziko nje ya nchi kwa kweli kunaweza kuongeza nafasi zako za kuingia katika elimu ya juu katika nchi yako ya nyumbani.

source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
reference: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.
hypothesis: Kwa kawaida, kuna ada ya masomo ya kujiandikisha katika programu hizo za elimu.

source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
reference: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. “Nchi ya maziwa elfu” ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.
hypothesis: Finland ni mahali pazuri pa kusafiri kwa mashua. "Nchi ya maziwa elfu" pia ina maelfu ya visiwa, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.

source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
reference: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.
hypothesis: Katika visiwa na maziwa huhitaji meli ya kuabiri.

source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
reference: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.
hypothesis: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi ni makubwa vya kutosha kwa meli yoyote, mashua ndogo au hata kayak hutoa ono tofauti.

source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
reference: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
hypothesis: Kuendesha mashua ni jambo la kupendeza sana nchini Finland, na kila watu saba au wanane wana mashua.

source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
reference: Hii inaendana na Norway, Sweden na Nyuzilandi, lakini vinginevyo ni tofauti kabisa (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).
hypothesis: Hii ni sawa na Norway, Sweden na New Zealand, lakini vinginevyo kabisa kipekee (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja hadi arobaini).

source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
reference: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.
hypothesis: Wengi wa tofauti Baltic Cruises kipengele kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St Petersburg, Urusi.

source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
reference: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.
hypothesis: Hii ina maana unaweza kutembelea mji wa kihistoria kwa siku kadhaa kamili wakati akirudi na kulala juu ya meli usiku.

source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
reference: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).
hypothesis: Kama wewe kwenda pwani tu kwa kutumia safari ya meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kutoka 2009).

source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
reference: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.
hypothesis: Baadhi ya cruises kuonyesha Berlin, Ujerumani katika broshua. Kama unaweza kuona kutoka ramani juu Berlin ni hakuna mahali karibu na bahari na ziara ya mji si pamoja na bei ya cruise.

source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
reference: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.
hypothesis: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa jambo lenye kuogopesha kwa watu wa umri na malezi mbalimbali, hasa ikiwa hawajawahi kusafiri kwa ndege au wamepitia tukio lenye kuumiza.

source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
reference: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.
hypothesis: Si jambo la kuaibikia: halitofautiani na hofu na chuki za kibinafsi za mambo mengine ambayo watu wengi sana wana.

source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
reference: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.
hypothesis: Kwa watu fulani, kuelewa mambo fulani kuhusu jinsi ndege zinavyofanya kazi na mambo yanayotukia wakati wa kukimbia kunaweza kuwasaidia kushinda woga unaotegemea mambo yasiyojulikana au kutojidhibiti.

source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
reference: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.
hypothesis: Mara nyingi, wakati ni muhimu sana kwa hati za biashara, bidhaa au vipuri kwa ajili ya ukarabati wa dharura.

source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
reference: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.
hypothesis: Katika baadhi ya njia, makampuni makubwa kuwa na ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na makampuni madogo kulikuwa na tatizo.

source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
reference: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.
hypothesis: Ikiwa walituma vitu kwa ndege, huenda katika njia fulani ilichukua siku kadhaa kupita kwenye vituo vya usafirishaji na forodha.

source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
reference: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.
hypothesis: Njia pekee ya kupata njia kwa haraka ilikuwa kutuma kama mizigo checked. sheria ya ndege si kuruhusu yao kutuma mizigo bila abiria, ambayo ni ambapo wewe kuja katika.

source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
reference: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).
hypothesis: Njia ya wazi ya kusafiri kwa darasa la kwanza au la biashara ni kulipa pesa nyingi kwa ajili ya pendeleo hilo (au, bora zaidi, kuuliza kampuni yako ikufanyie hivyo).

source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
reference: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!
hypothesis: Hata hivyo, si rahisi: kama sheria ya msingi, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kodi ya kawaida ya kiuchumi kwa biashara, na mara kumi na moja kwa darasa la kwanza!

source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
reference: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.
hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, hakuna haja ya kutafuta punguzo hata kwa ajili ya viti vya darasa la kwanza au la biashara kwenye ndege za moja kwa moja kutoka A hadi B.

source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
reference: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.
hypothesis: Mashirika ya ndege yanajua vizuri kwamba kuna kikundi fulani cha watu ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi sana ili wapate nafasi ya kusafiri haraka na kwa starehe, na wanahitaji kulipa ada inayofaa.

source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
reference: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.
hypothesis: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chişinău. Lugha ya wenyeji ni Kiromania, lakini Kirusi hutumiwa sana.

source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
reference: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.
hypothesis: Moldova ni jamhuri yenye makabila mengi ambayo imeathiriwa na migogoro ya kikabila.

source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
reference: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
hypothesis: Katika 1994, mgogoro huo ulisababisha kuanzishwa kwa Jamhuri ya Transnistria iliyojitangaza katika mashariki mwa Moldova, ambayo ina serikali na sarafu yake mwenyewe lakini haitambuliwi na nchi yoyote ya Umoja wa Mataifa.

source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
reference: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.
hypothesis: Uhusiano wa kiuchumi umeanzishwa upya kati ya sehemu hizo mbili za Moldova licha ya kushindwa kwa mazungumzo ya kisiasa.

source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
reference: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.
hypothesis: Dini kuu nchini Moldova ni Ukristo wa Othodoksi.

source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
reference: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.
hypothesis: İzmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu karibu milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha usafiri.

source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
reference: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.
hypothesis: Jiji la kale la Smurna lilikuwa kituo cha biashara chenye shughuli nyingi, na sasa ni jiji la kisasa, lenye maendeleo, lililozungukwa na milima na lililozungukwa na ghuba kubwa.

source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
reference: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.
hypothesis: Barabara pana, majengo yenye madirisha na vituo vya kisasa vya ununuzi vimejaa paa za kawaida za vigae vyekundu, soko la karne ya 18, na misikiti na makanisa ya kale, ingawa jiji hilo lina hali ya Ulaya ya Mediterania kuliko Uturuki ya kawaida.
